scope: Purposively selected published arguments and institutional documents; not a population sample, activist roster or operational network.
analysis_status: AI-assisted documentary interpretation. No independent coding, author verification, interviews, behavioral observation or causal estimation.

provenance.retained_records: E01-E10 retain v2 source findings; their original access is not represented as repeated independent verification.
provenance.new_records: E11-E14 were inspected in round 3.0 on 2026-10-15, America/Chicago.
provenance.schema_revision: Separate mode, stance, outcomes, authority and coding checks. The old E07 negative-control label becomes a known-answer coding check; original history remains at the previous blob.

counting_rule: 14 records from 10 receiving documents. Repeated documents and shared institutions are dependent; counts describe this register alone.
privacy_rule: Public publication names and source locators only. No private identity resolution, inferred affiliations, contact details or operational activity maps.

field_contract.null_semantics: Null institutional cluster means not assigned in this register, not demonstrated institutional independence. Absent outcomes are unestablished, not proven absent.

interpretation_boundaries: Textual use, reported learning, posted governance, reported adoption and observed practice are distinct outcomes.
No record independently verifies changed behavior caused by the named source.
A source category can have overlapping identities; DSA publication does not imply its writer has no anarchist commitments, and XR is not treated as uniformly anarchist.
The register establishes attributed relations, not global prevalence, source exclusivity or a measured directional gradient.
A posted institutional instrument is evidence of a document, not a certificate that its stated process was enacted.
The E07 known-answer check cannot estimate sensitivity, specificity or a causal negative-control effect.
Later citations to this register cannot increase the count of independent source evidence.
